meta.title: KNOWLEDGE X — Frontend–Backend & Module Communication
meta.subtitle: Complete Dependency Graph Across app.py, All 7 Pages, All 8 Domain Modules, Evaluation Scripts & Storage

components.label: app.py
components.explanation: Initializes session_state keys, injects assets/style.css, runs _handle_google_auth_lifecycle(), draws sidebar avatar popover and model controls, and routes to all 7 pages.

components.label: dashboard.py
components.explanation: Drives 3-channel document intake and orchestrates the 4-stage Full AI Synthesis Pipeline directly into session_state and SQLite.

components.label: knowledge_analysis
components.explanation: Calls analyze_documents() and detect_research_gaps(), persists sessions via history_db, and builds Plotly concept & coverage charts.

components.label: knowledge_map
components.explanation: Supports AI extraction or instant PyMuPDF structural graph synthesis, computes NetworkX metrics, and plots an interactive Plotly map.

components.label: research_assistant
components.explanation: Filters active corpus via st.multiselect and sends user questions to answer_research_question() with top-10 chunk grounding.

components.label: ambiguity_detector
components.explanation: Stateful wizard running process_initial_question(), rendering radio/custom clarification controls, executing complete_clarified_question(), and archiving results.

components.label: research_history
components.explanation: Enforces Google auth_user guard, lists research_sessions and ambiguity_history scoped by user_id, and reconstructs graphs or Markdown exports.

components.label: profile.py
components.explanation: Displays Google profile avatar, verified identity fields, get_user_history_summary(), and workspace corpus KPIs.

components.label: ocr_scanner.py
components.explanation: Validates contrast/sharpness via NumPy, extracts structured OCR text per page, and embeds invisible render_mode=3 text layers in PyMuPDF PDFs.

components.label: research_gap.py
components.explanation: Consumes multi-document contexts through ai_analysis.generate_structured_json() and builds topic coverage matrices.

components.label: knowledge_map
components.explanation: Creates typed knowledge graphs from AI extraction, synthesis outputs, or PyMuPDF term co-occurrence fallback.

components.label: ambiguity_detector
components.explanation: Combines deterministic comparison guard with Gemini JSON classification and question rewriting before delegating final QA to ai_analysis.

components.label: evaluation/
components.explanation: Offline CLI scripts generating curated benchmark questions and computing Clear / Ambiguous / Insufficient Context evaluation metrics.

components.label: pdf_reader.py
components.explanation: Parses PDFs, enforces URL SSRF/DNS/size rules, computes corpus KPIs, builds token-budgeted contexts, and retrieves weighted chunks.

components.label: ai_analysis.py
components.explanation: Shared AI gateway providing generate_structured_json(), analyze_documents(), answer_research_question(), Markdown export, and secret redaction.

components.label: auth.py
components.explanation: Handles OAuth config, PKCE/state DB tracking, Google token exchange, OIDC verify_oauth2_token, signed cookies, and user upload directory hashing.

components.label: history_db.py
components.explanation: Manages knowledge_x_history.db schema migrations, secret scrubbing, and user_id-isolated save/list/get/delete APIs.

components.label: SQLite & uploads/
components.explanation: Shared persistence backing both authentication state and per-user research outputs and uploaded PDF documents.

cards.title: Layered In-Process Dependency DAG
items: app.py dispatches all 7 pages via st.navigation(position='sidebar') and centralizes auth, corpus state, and model settings.
Domain modules (ocr_scanner, research_gap, knowledge_map, ambiguity_detector) sit cleanly between UI pages and core services (pdf_reader, ai_analysis, auth, history_db).

cards.title: Direct Python Contracts & Offline Eval
items: No internal REST endpoints: pages import module APIs and handle AIServiceError, PDFProcessingError, ScanProcessingError, AuthenticationError, and HistoryStorageError.
evaluation/ scripts exercise process_initial_question() directly without running Streamlit.
